plan_summary: Authenticate safely, identify Christopher and their latest relevant movie-request text, locate and read the matching Simple Note data, derive a comma-separated title list, send it by text, verify the exact sent record, and complete the task.

steps.reasoning: The public documentation must be inspected before any task API is called so later calls use only documented parameters and response fields.
steps.action_code:
api_docs = {}
for app_name, api_name in [
    ("supervisor", "show_profile"),
    ("supervisor", "show_account_passwords"),
    ("supervisor", "complete_task"),
    ("phone", "login"),
    ("phone", "search_contacts"),
    ("phone", "search_text_messages"),
    ("phone", "send_text_message"),
    ("simple_note", "login"),
    ("simple_note", "search_notes"),
    ("simple_note", "show_note"),
]:
    api_docs[(app_name, api_name)] = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name=app_name, api_name=api_name)
verification_targets: Public documentation is available for every task API before its first use.

steps.reasoning: With the contracts inspected, retrieve the supervisor profile and account credentials, then authenticate to the phone without exposing secrets.
verification_targets: Supervisor profile is saved.
Phone access token is saved without printing credentials.
Simple Note password remains available only in a variable for later authentication.

steps.reasoning: Christopher's phone number must come from the contact book rather than being guessed, and every search-results page must be read.
steps.action_code:
contact_search_results = []
contact_page_index = 0
while True:
    contact_page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, query="Christopher", page_index=contact_page_index, page_limit=20)
    contact_search_results.extend(contact_page)
    if len(contact_page) < 20:
        break
    contact_page_index += 1
christopher_contacts = [contact for contact in contact_search_results if contact["first_name"].strip().casefold() == "christopher"]
assert christopher_contacts, "No exact Christopher contact was found"
print([{"contact_id": contact["contact_id"], "name": (contact["first_name"] + " " + contact["last_name"]).strip(), "phone_number": contact["phone_number"]} for contact in christopher_contacts])
verification_targets: All contact-search pages have been read.
At least one exact first-name match for Christopher is available for message inspection.

steps.reasoning: If multiple Christopher contacts exist, their incoming text histories provide the evidence needed to identify who made the movie-recommendation request; all pages for each candidate must be read.
verification_targets: Every message page for every exact Christopher contact has been read.
Incoming messages from the candidate contacts are saved separately from outgoing messages.

steps.reasoning: The requesting contact and request text can now be selected from real incoming messages by relevance to movies and recommendations, preferring the latest relevant request.
verification_targets: The selected request is an incoming Christopher message relevant to movies or recommendations.
The recipient contact and request text are derived from public records.

steps.reasoning: The selected request establishes what must be found in Simple Note, so authenticate there using the saved supervisor email and credential.
steps.action_code:
simple_note_auth = apis.simple_note.login(username=supervisor_profile["email"], password=simple_note_password)
simple_note_access_token = simple_note_auth["access_token"]
del simple_note_password
verification_targets: Simple Note access token is saved without printing the password or token.

steps.reasoning: Enumerating all note metadata avoids guessing a note ID or relying on a possibly incomplete title query, and every pagination page must be consumed.
steps.action_code:
note_summaries = []
note_page_index = 0
while True:
    note_page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_access_token, query="", dont_reorder_pinned=True, page_index=note_page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by="+updated_at")
    note_summaries.extend(note_page)
    if len(note_page) < 20:
        break
    note_page_index += 1
assert note_summaries, "No Simple Note records were found"
print([{"note_id": note["note_id"], "title": note["title"], "tags": note["tags"], "updated_at": note["updated_at"]} for note in note_summaries])
verification_targets: Every page of note metadata has been read.
Candidate note IDs, titles, tags, and update times are saved from real results.

steps.reasoning: Note metadata does not contain movie titles, so each candidate's documented detail record must be read before selecting the requested list.
steps.action_code:
note_details = [apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note["note_id"], access_token=simple_note_access_token) for note in note_summaries]
print([{"note_id": note["note_id"], "title": note["title"], "tags": note["tags"], "content": note["content"], "updated_at": note["updated_at"]} for note in note_details])
verification_targets: Detailed content has been retrieved for every candidate note using IDs returned by note search.

steps.reasoning: Before sending anything, use the real request terms and note contents to select the best-matching note, normalize its list into comma-separated titles, and review the exact recipient and payload.
verification_targets: The source note is selected from retrieved records using request-relevant terms.
The outgoing content is a nonempty comma-and-space-separated list derived from note content.
The reviewed recipient is the Christopher contact associated with the selected incoming request.

steps.reasoning: The recipient and payload have been independently derived and reviewed, so send the requested reply and retain its returned identifier for verification.
verification_targets: The send API returns a text-message identifier for the reviewed payload.

steps.reasoning: The send response alone is insufficient evidence of the stored postcondition, so re-read the complete conversation and verify the exact returned message ID, direction, recipient, and content.
steps.action_code:
verification_messages = []
verification_page_index = 0
while True:
    verification_page = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_access_token, query="", phone_number=requesting_contact["phone_number"], only_latest_per_contact=False, page_index=verification_page_index, page_limit=20)
    verification_messages.extend(verification_page)
    if len(verification_page) < 20:
        break
    verification_page_index += 1
matching_sent_records = [message for message in verification_messages if message["text_message_id"] == sent_text_message_id]
assert len(matching_sent_records) == 1, "The sent text record was not uniquely found"
verified_sent_record = matching_sent_records[0]
postcondition_checks = {
    "message_id_found": True,
    "content_matches": verified_sent_record["message"] == outgoing_message,
    "sender_matches_supervisor": normalize_phone(verified_sent_record["sender"]["phone_number"]) == normalize_phone(supervisor_profile["phone_number"]),
    "recipient_matches_requester": normalize_phone(verified_sent_record["receiver"]["phone_number"]) == normalize_phone(requesting_contact["phone_number"]),
}
print(postcondition_checks)
assert all(postcondition_checks.values()), postcondition_checks
verification_targets: The exact sent message ID exists in the re-queried public conversation.
Its content equals the derived comma-separated title list.
Its sender is the supervisor and its recipient is the requesting Christopher.

steps.reasoning: The requested text has been re-queried and all requested postconditions have been checked, so the action task can now be marked successful without an answer value.
